title: The trailer for my game (GBA)
author: SaraSolGames
selftext:
I tried to make a funny trailer for my game:  
[https://sarasol.itch.io/babale-from-vlora](https://sarasol.itch.io/babale-from-vlora)

Game designed by me, code by ClaudeCode and art by ChatGPT

Hope you enjoy it!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/SaraSolGames please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

comments.author: Gloomy_Mess_9822
comments.body: From video it seems like theres no combos and enemy stagger so it just non functional as beatemup.

replies.author: SaraSolGames
replies.body: You can try it. It has also Boss riposte too. Sorry couldnt show everything in the video.

replies.author: Gloomy_Mess_9822
replies.body: I am not going to try that. Im sorry dude, but this looks like a kid project. At lesst kid can be complimented to encourage development, but you are a grown ass man who did same amount of work and effort as me typing this post.

replies.author: SaraSolGames
replies.body: It is ok. You can have your own opinion. But still I invite you to try the game before you come to final conclusions. And if you don't still fine by me. I wish you a great day!

replies.author: Gloomy_Mess_9822
replies.body: I will not try it because im a game developer and i see critical flaws and mistakes in the video. Its a shitpost.

replies.author: SaraSolGames
replies.body: Good for you. Wish you luck in your games. I hope people try games and not be negative without trying them.
